Column_definition: Name of the 50x50m subplot. Subplots are oriented along the main cardinal directions.
Unique and consistent stem id
Species code
Easting of the tree coordinate. Reference system EPSG 31468
Northing of the tree coordinate. Reference system EPSG 31468
Easting of the tree coordinate relative to the south-western edge of the plot. Calculated from easting_m.
Northing of the tree coordinate relative to the south-western edge of the plot. Calculated from northing_m.
Information whether the tree is/was in a (formerly) fenced area (1) or not (0). See readme.md for information on fences.
Number/name of the fenced area the tree is part of
Year of the forest inventory
Diameter at breast height (1.3m) or at pom in centimeters
Dbh measured (0) or estimated (1). NA if dbh is NA

Life status. A for living trees; D for dead trees; M for trees that could not be found or - in 2023 - were too small for inclusion in the inventory; and P for trees prior to their first inclusion in an inventory
Sociological tree class according to G. Kraft
Vitality of the tree in 3 categories
Coverage by other crowns in 3 categories. NA if dbh is NA or estimated
Recorded damages on trees
Point (i.e. height) of measurement. 1.3m if NA
Cause of death
Type of the dead tree according to Mueller-Using et al 2003
Decay class of the dead tree according to Mueller-Using et al 2003
Raw comments/remarks as written by the data collector
Date of the observation in format yyyy-mm-dd
Potential problems with the observation/tree
